title: Hermes Checkpoint
description: Schema for Hermes v0.13 checkpoints and session auto-resume. Pending output is not auto-delivered on resume and resume creates audit events.

subject_id.description: Required. Subject ID to scope the checkpoint.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when checkpoint was created.

session_id.description: Session ID this checkpoint belongs to.

has_pending_output.description: Whether there is pending output at this checkpoint.

pending_output_not_auto_delivered.description: Whether pending output is blocked from auto-delivery on resume.

pending_output_visible_to_researcher.description: Whether pending output is shown to researcher on resume.

resume_requires_explicit_user_action.description: Whether resume requires explicit user action or researcher gate.

audit_event_on_resume.description: Whether resume creates an audit event.

last_resume_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when session was last resumed.
